expiryEvidence.note: Owner reports Meta Access Token Debugger / UI shows no expiry date for the current long-lived token. Not an API verification performed by the agent. expiresAt=null alone is not sufficient — mode+evidence required.

refreshNote: Owner refreshed long-lived token + Cloud Run redeploy; Meta UI shows no expiry (owner-reported)
howToSetExpiry: If Meta shows an expires_at: set expiryMode=limited, paste ISO datetime into expiresAt, set expiresAtTimezone, set expiryEvidence.source to debug_token|app_dashboard
If Meta shows no expiry (owner report): set expiryMode=none, expiresAt=null, expiryEvidence.source=owner-reported-meta with reportedAt — do not invent a date
If unknown: expiryMode=unknown, expiresAt=null — office alerts unverified; never invent
Never paste the access token into this file, briefs, logs, or PRs
